name: English
_purpose: Every word scripts/second.py says to a person, and (keys starting with say_) the sentences the skills say, printed by `second.py words`. Keep every {placeholder}. A missing key falls back to this file.
list_none: There is no second program from another company on this computer.
list_none_browser: That isn't a malfunction: you can get a second opinion for free, in another company's browser chat - just do that.
list_found: Found {count} program(s) from another company, already installed and signed in:
why_none: no second program from another company
why_allowance: this program's monthly or daily allowance has run out
say_cost: You have {who} on this computer. I'll ask it the same question. That will use up a little of your monthly allowance with them - you don't need a second subscription.
say_browser: There's no second program on this computer, and that's not a problem: open any free chat from another company in your browser and paste this into it. Then send me back what it answers.
say_allowance: {who} didn't answer just now - it's run out of its monthly allowance. That's not a malfunction and you don't need to pay for it: the allowance comes back on its own. You can get a second opinion for free in the browser.
say_not_proof: Two AIs agreeing is not proof.
